summary.text: Lisa Krasner is a Republican member of the Nevada State Senate who has represented District 16 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously served in the Nevada State Assembly from 2016 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Krasner earned a B.A. from the University of California, Los Angeles, and a J.D. from the University of La Verne College of Law.

Her career experience includes working as an instructor at Truckee Meadows Community College and the University of Phoenix, and she has served on the Nevada Commission on Aging and Disability, the Reno Parks and Recreation Commission, and as a state director for the National Foundation for Women Legislators.
She represented District 26 in the Nevada State Assembly from 2016 to 2022 and assumed office in the Senate on November 9, 2022, succeeding Donald Tatro.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Senate Government Affairs, Senate Judiciary, and Senate Legislative Operations and Elections committees.
Her Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election is Chrystal Roll.
